name: casestack
description: Transform raw project material into senior-level portfolio case studies with structured content, gap-fill interviews, and production-ready Next.js pages.

skills.name: case-study
skills.description: Main entry point for creating portfolio case studies. Routes to ingest, interview, write, and generate sub-skills.

skills.name: case-study/ingest
skills.description: Ingest project material (docs, PDFs, Figma files, notes) and extract structured content.

skills.name: case-study/interview
skills.description: Gap-fill interview to capture missing senior case-study content.

skills.name: case-study/write
skills.description: Generate case study content following senior rubric and writing rules.

skills.name: case-study/architecture
skills.description: Reference for senior case-study architecture and what hiring managers look for.

skills.name: case-study/page-generator
skills.description: Generate Next.js case study pages matching the portfolio's existing conventions.

skills.name: case-study/review
skills.description: Score case study against senior rubric and verify build/accessibility.
